cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.20)
get_filename_component(PERCEPTION_PROJECT_ROOT "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/.." ABSOLUTE)
project(perception_full_shared_sdk VERSION 0.36.0 LANGUAGES C CXX)
# Source profiles live three levels below the canonical models/ directory.
# An installed SDK is self-contained: config/, profiles/ and models/ are peers,
# so install copies use ../models/ regardless of the chosen install prefix.
set(PERCEPTION_SDK_RUNTIME_PROFILES_DIR "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/runtime_config/profiles")
set(PERCEPTION_SDK_RUNTIME_TEMPLATES_DIR "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/runtime_config/config")
foreach(_runtime_kind profiles sdk_templates)
  if(_runtime_kind STREQUAL "profiles")
    set(_runtime_destination "${PERCEPTION_SDK_RUNTIME_PROFILES_DIR}")
  else()
    set(_runtime_destination "${PERCEPTION_SDK_RUNTIME_TEMPLATES_DIR}")
  endif()
  file(MAKE_DIRECTORY "${_runtime_destination}")
  file(GLOB _runtime_sources CONFIGURE_DEPENDS
    "${PERCEPTION_PROJECT_ROOT}/scheduling/config/${_runtime_kind}/*.json"
    "${PERCEPTION_PROJECT_ROOT}/scheduling/config/${_runtime_kind}/*.cfg")
  foreach(_runtime_source IN LISTS _runtime_sources)
    set_property(DIRECTORY APPEND PROPERTY CMAKE_CONFIGURE_DEPENDS "${_runtime_source}")
    get_filename_component(_runtime_name "${_runtime_source}" NAME)
    file(READ "${_runtime_source}" _runtime_text)
    string(REPLACE "../../../models/" "../models/" _runtime_text "${_runtime_text}")
    file(WRITE "${_runtime_destination}/${_runtime_name}" "${_runtime_text}")
  endforeach()
endforeach()

  target_compile_options(legacy_exact PRIVATE /utf-8 /fp:strict)

  target_compile_options(legacy_reference PRIVATE -fno-fast-math -ffp-contract=fast)
  target_compile_options(legacy_exact PRIVATE -fno-fast-math -ffp-contract=off)
  target_compile_options(app_support PRIVATE -Wall -Wextra -fno-fast-math)
endif()
if(R20_WITH_BPU)
  if(NOT CMAKE_SYSTEM_NAME STREQUAL "Linux" OR NOT CMAKE_SYSTEM_PROCESSOR MATCHES "aarch64|arm64")
    message(FATAL_ERROR "R20_WITH_BPU requires real Linux AArch64 cross-build")
  endif()
  find_path(HORIZON_INCLUDE dnn/hb_dnn.h HINTS ${HORIZON_ROOT}/include REQUIRED)
  find_library(HORIZON_DNN NAMES dnn HINTS ${HORIZON_ROOT}/lib ${HORIZON_ROOT}/lib/hbbpu REQUIRED)
  find_library(HORIZON_HBRT NAMES hbrt_bayes_aarch64 HINTS ${HORIZON_ROOT}/lib ${HORIZON_ROOT}/lib/hbbpu REQUIRED)
  set(CAMERA_SDK_INCLUDE "${PERCEPTION_PROJECT_ROOT}/third_party/mo_sdk/include" CACHE PATH "Original Mo SDK headers")
  target_include_directories(app_support SYSTEM PRIVATE ${CAMERA_SDK_INCLUDE})
  target_compile_definitions(app_support PRIVATE PERCEPTION_MO_VENDOR_TYPES_AVAILABLE=1)
  find_path(VPF_INCLUDE hbn_api.h HINTS ${HORIZON_ROOT}/include REQUIRED)
  include("${PERCEPTION_PROJECT_ROOT}/sdk/cmake/x5-vpf.cmake")
  perception_find_x5_vpf()
  find_library(HBMEM_LIBRARY NAMES hbmem libhbmem.so.1 libhbmem.so.1.0.0 HINTS ${HORIZON_ROOT}/hobot/lib ${HORIZON_ROOT}/lib NAMES_PER_DIR REQUIRED)
  target_compile_definitions(hardware_routes PRIVATE HW_AB_WITH_X5=1)
  target_include_directories(hardware_routes PRIVATE ${HORIZON_INCLUDE} ${VPF_INCLUDE})
  target_link_libraries(hardware_routes PUBLIC ${HORIZON_DNN} ${HORIZON_HBRT} ${VPF_LIBRARY} ${HBMEM_LIBRARY})
  add_library(original_runner STATIC "${PERCEPTION_PROJECT_ROOT}/features/inference/backend/src/runner.cpp"
    ${R36_FEATURE_POSTPROCESS_SOURCES})
  target_include_directories(original_runner PUBLIC "${PERCEPTION_PROJECT_ROOT}/scheduling/runtime/include" "${PERCEPTION_PROJECT_ROOT}/features/inference/preprocess/include" "${PERCEPTION_PROJECT_ROOT}/scheduling/runtime/include" PRIVATE ${HORIZON_INCLUDE})
  target_link_libraries(original_runner PUBLIC execution_schedule exact_input seg_post hardware_routes ${HORIZON_DNN} ${HORIZON_HBRT} Threads::Threads)
  target_compile_options(original_runner PRIVATE -fno-fast-math -ffp-contract=fast)
  if(PERCEPTION_LINK_DEPENDENCY_DIRS)
    foreach(directory IN LISTS PERCEPTION_LINK_DEPENDENCY_DIRS)
      target_link_options(original_runner PUBLIC "-Wl,-rpath-link,${directory}")
    endforeach()
  endif()
endif()

if(R29_WITH_ORT)
  if(R20_WITH_BPU OR CMAKE_CROSSCOMPILING OR NOT CMAKE_SIZEOF_VOID_P EQUAL 8 OR
     NOT CMAKE_SYSTEM_PROCESSOR MATCHES "^(AMD64|amd64|x86_64|x64)$")
    message(FATAL_ERROR "R29_WITH_ORT requires a native x86-64 build with R20_WITH_BPU=OFF")
  endif()
  if(NOT ORT_ROOT AND CPU_ONNX_RUNTIME_ROOT)
    set(ORT_ROOT "${CPU_ONNX_RUNTIME_ROOT}")
  endif()
  find_path(ORT_INCLUDE_DIR onnxruntime_cxx_api.h PATHS "${ORT_ROOT}/include" NO_DEFAULT_PATH REQUIRED)
  find_library(ORT_LIBRARY NAMES onnxruntime PATHS "${ORT_ROOT}/lib" NO_DEFAULT_PATH REQUIRED)
  add_library(onnxruntime_cpu_sdk SHARED IMPORTED)
  if(WIN32)
    find_file(ORT_RUNTIME onnxruntime.dll PATHS "${ORT_ROOT}/lib" "${ORT_ROOT}/bin" NO_DEFAULT_PATH REQUIRED)
    set_target_properties(onnxruntime_cpu_sdk PROPERTIES IMPORTED_IMPLIB "${ORT_LIBRARY}" IMPORTED_LOCATION "${ORT_RUNTIME}")
  else()
    set(ORT_RUNTIME "${ORT_LIBRARY}")
    set_target_properties(onnxruntime_cpu_sdk PROPERTIES IMPORTED_LOCATION "${ORT_LIBRARY}")
  endif()
  add_library(cpu_onnx_stages STATIC "${PERCEPTION_PROJECT_ROOT}/features/inference/cpu/src/cpu_stages.cpp" "${PERCEPTION_PROJECT_ROOT}/scheduling/config/src/cpu_config.cpp")
  target_include_directories(cpu_onnx_stages PUBLIC "${PERCEPTION_PROJECT_ROOT}/features/inference/preprocess/include" "${PERCEPTION_PROJECT_ROOT}/scheduling/runtime/include" PRIVATE "${ORT_INCLUDE_DIR}" "${PERCEPTION_PROJECT_ROOT}/features/inference/framework/src")
  target_link_libraries(cpu_onnx_stages PUBLIC exact_input seg_post runtime_status onnxruntime_cpu_sdk)
  if(MSVC)
    target_compile_options(cpu_onnx_stages PRIVATE /utf-8 /EHsc /fp:strict)
  else()
    target_compile_options(cpu_onnx_stages PRIVATE -fno-fast-math -ffp-contract=off)
  endif()
endif()
add_executable(dag_flow_worker "${PERCEPTION_PROJECT_ROOT}/scheduling/launch/src/dag_flow_worker.cpp")
target_include_directories(dag_flow_worker PRIVATE "${PERCEPTION_PROJECT_ROOT}/scheduling/runtime/include" "${PERCEPTION_PROJECT_ROOT}/features/inference/preprocess/include")
target_link_libraries(dag_flow_worker PRIVATE dag_exact_features app_support platform_metrics)
if(R29_WITH_ORT)
  target_compile_definitions(dag_flow_worker PRIVATE R29_WITH_ORT=1)
  target_link_libraries(dag_flow_worker PRIVATE cpu_onnx_stages)
  if(WIN32)
    add_custom_command(TARGET dag_flow_worker POST_BUILD COMMAND ${CMAKE_COMMAND} -E copy_if_different "${ORT_RUNTIME}" "$<TARGET_FILE_DIR:dag_flow_worker>")
    install(FILES "${ORT_RUNTIME}" DESTINATION bin)
  else()
    set_target_properties(dag_flow_worker PROPERTIES INSTALL_RPATH "$ORIGIN/../lib")
    file(GLOB _ort_shared_libraries "${ORT_ROOT}/lib/libonnxruntime.so*")
    install(FILES ${_ort_shared_libraries} DESTINATION lib)
  endif()
  foreach(_notice IN ITEMS LICENSE ThirdPartyNotices.txt VERSION_NUMBER)
    if(EXISTS "${ORT_ROOT}/${_notice}")
      install(FILES "${ORT_ROOT}/${_notice}" DESTINATION licenses/onnxruntime)
    endif()
  endforeach()
endif()
if(R20_WITH_BPU)
  target_compile_definitions(dag_flow_worker PRIVATE R20_WITH_BPU=1)
  target_link_libraries(dag_flow_worker PRIVATE original_runner)
endif()
if(MSVC)
  target_compile_options(dag_flow_worker PRIVATE /utf-8 /EHsc /fp:precise)
  # Windows 10 1903+: make narrow argv/filesystem paths UTF-8, matching JSON
  # and Python's Unicode command line. Source encoding flags alone do not do this.
  foreach(_utf8_target IN ITEMS dag_flow_worker visualize_saved_frame)
    target_link_options(${_utf8_target} PRIVATE "/MANIFEST:EMBED" "/MANIFESTINPUT:${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/cmake/windows_utf8.manifest")
  endforeach()
endif()

  target_include_directories(three_parallel_tests PRIVATE "${PERCEPTION_PROJECT_ROOT}/features/inference/preprocess/include" "${PERCEPTION_PROJECT_ROOT}/scheduling/runtime/include" "${PERCEPTION_PROJECT_ROOT}/scheduling/runtime/include")
  target_link_libraries(three_parallel_tests PRIVATE dag_exact_features)
  if(MSVC)
    target_compile_options(background_drain_tests PRIVATE /utf-8 /EHsc)
    target_compile_options(three_parallel_tests PRIVATE /utf-8 /EHsc /fp:strict)
  endif()
  add_test(NAME background_RGBD_drain_lifetime_and_evidence COMMAND background_drain_tests)
  add_test(NAME same_frame_three_branch_parallel_DAG COMMAND three_parallel_tests "${PERCEPTION_PROJECT_ROOT}/scheduling/config/profiles")
  if(MSVC AND NOT R20_WITH_BPU)
    add_executable(camera_adapter_tests "${PERCEPTION_PROJECT_ROOT}/validation/sdk/tests/camera_adapter_tests.cpp" "${PERCEPTION_PROJECT_ROOT}/features/camera/backend/src/camera_source.cpp")

    target_compile_options(camera_adapter_tests PRIVATE /utf-8 /EHsc /FI${PERCEPTION_PROJECT_ROOT}/validation/sdk/tests/fake_dl/compiler_compat.h)
    target_link_libraries(camera_adapter_tests PRIVATE app_support)
    add_test(NAME host_camera_adapter_mock_NOT_HARDWARE COMMAND camera_adapter_tests)
    add_executable(camera_callback_tests "${PERCEPTION_PROJECT_ROOT}/validation/sdk/tests/camera_callback_tests.cpp" "${PERCEPTION_PROJECT_ROOT}/features/camera/backend/src/camera_source.cpp")
    target_include_directories(camera_callback_tests PRIVATE "${PERCEPTION_PROJECT_ROOT}/validation/sdk/tests/fake_dl" "${PERCEPTION_PROJECT_ROOT}/third_party/mo_sdk/include")
    target_compile_definitions(camera_callback_tests PRIVATE __linux__=1 PERCEPTION_MO_VENDOR_TYPES_AVAILABLE=1)
    target_compile_options(camera_callback_tests PRIVATE /utf-8 /EHsc /FI${PERCEPTION_PROJECT_ROOT}/validation/sdk/tests/fake_dl/compiler_compat.h)
    target_link_libraries(camera_callback_tests PRIVATE app_support)
    add_test(NAME host_callback_NULL_rejection_and_demand_NOT_HARDWARE COMMAND camera_callback_tests)
  endif()
  add_executable(resource_lifecycle_tests "${PERCEPTION_PROJECT_ROOT}/validation/sdk/tests/resource_lifecycle_tests.cpp")
  target_include_directories(resource_lifecycle_tests PRIVATE "${PERCEPTION_PROJECT_ROOT}/features/inference/preprocess/include" "${PERCEPTION_PROJECT_ROOT}/features/camera/backend/include")
  if(MSVC)
    target_compile_options(resource_lifecycle_tests PRIVATE /utf-8 /EHsc)
  endif()
  add_test(NAME resource_snapshot_and_camera_close_policy COMMAND resource_lifecycle_tests)
  add_executable(hardware_linkage_tests "${PERCEPTION_PROJECT_ROOT}/validation/sdk/tests/hardware_linkage_tests.cpp")
  # Intentionally link only hardware_routes: its transitive dependency must
  # provide Tensor::validate, including for the real ARM calibration target.
  target_link_libraries(hardware_linkage_tests PRIVATE hardware_routes)
  if(MSVC)
    target_compile_options(hardware_linkage_tests PRIVATE /utf-8 /EHsc)
  endif()
  add_test(NAME hardware_dependency_static_link COMMAND hardware_linkage_tests)
  add_executable(exact_input_tests "${PERCEPTION_PROJECT_ROOT}/validation/sdk/tests/exact_input_tests.cpp")
  target_link_libraries(exact_input_tests PRIVATE exact_input)
  if(MSVC)
    target_compile_options(exact_input_tests PRIVATE /utf-8 /fp:strict /EHsc)
  else()
    target_compile_options(exact_input_tests PRIVATE -fno-fast-math -ffp-contract=fast)
  endif()
  add_test(NAME r22_cached_direct_zero_bytes COMMAND exact_input_tests)
  add_test(NAME r23_compact_zero_bytes COMMAND exact_input_tests --compact)
  if(R20_WITH_BPU)
    target_compile_definitions(exact_input_tests PRIVATE R22_NATIVE_REFERENCE_TEST=1)
    target_link_libraries(exact_input_tests PRIVATE original_runner)
  endif()
  if(R21_HORIZON_TEST_INCLUDE AND NOT R20_WITH_BPU)
    add_executable(product_inference_contract_tests "${PERCEPTION_PROJECT_ROOT}/validation/sdk/tests/product_inference_contract_tests.cpp" "${PERCEPTION_PROJECT_ROOT}/features/inference/backend/src/runner.cpp" "${PERCEPTION_PROJECT_ROOT}/features/inference/product/src/exact_dnn_runner.cpp"

      target_compile_options(product_inference_contract_tests PRIVATE /utf-8 /EHsc /fp:precise)

      target_compile_options(product_inference_contract_tests PRIVATE -fno-fast-math -ffp-contract=fast)
    endif()
    add_test(NAME product_independent_lanes_serial_and_input_contract_NOT_BPU COMMAND product_inference_contract_tests "${PERCEPTION_PROJECT_ROOT}/scheduling/config/profiles")
    # The mock API only makes the unchanged real runner helper link on a host.
    # This contract test does not call model inference or establish ARM parity.
    add_executable(original_input_native_harness "${PERCEPTION_PROJECT_ROOT}/validation/sdk/tests/original_input_native_harness.cpp" "${PERCEPTION_PROJECT_ROOT}/features/inference/backend/src/runner.cpp"

    target_include_directories(dag_native_harness PRIVATE "${PERCEPTION_PROJECT_ROOT}/scheduling/runtime/include" "${PERCEPTION_PROJECT_ROOT}/features/inference/preprocess/include" "${PERCEPTION_PROJECT_ROOT}/scheduling/runtime/include" ${R21_HORIZON_TEST_INCLUDE})

    add_test(NAME original_DAG_native_stages_NOT_BPU COMMAND dag_native_harness "${PERCEPTION_PROJECT_ROOT}/scheduling/config/profiles")
    add_executable(runner_harness_tests "${PERCEPTION_PROJECT_ROOT}/validation/sdk/tests/runner_harness.cpp" "${PERCEPTION_PROJECT_ROOT}/features/inference/backend/src/runner.cpp")

install(TARGETS dag_flow_worker visualize_saved_frame RUNTIME DESTINATION bin)
install(DIRECTORY "${PERCEPTION_SDK_RUNTIME_PROFILES_DIR}/" DESTINATION profiles)
install(DIRECTORY "${PERCEPTION_PROJECT_ROOT}/scheduling/runtime/include/" DESTINATION include)
# Preserve the new layout when developer sources are requested. Historical
# archive files are not installed as active SDK implementation.
foreach(_source_layer core features scheduling sdk third_party archive validation docs models calibration)
  install(DIRECTORY "${PERCEPTION_PROJECT_ROOT}/${_source_layer}"
    DESTINATION source COMPONENT DeveloperSources
    PATTERN "__pycache__" EXCLUDE PATTERN "*.pyc" EXCLUDE PATTERN "*.py" EXCLUDE)
endforeach()
install(FILES "${PERCEPTION_PROJECT_ROOT}/README_zh.md"
  "${PERCEPTION_PROJECT_ROOT}/pipeline.json" "${PERCEPTION_PROJECT_ROOT}/camera.json"
  "${PERCEPTION_PROJECT_ROOT}/visualization.json" "${PERCEPTION_PROJECT_ROOT}/parameter_map.json"
  DESTINATION source COMPONENT DeveloperSources)

if(BUILD_TESTING AND R33_WITH_MAPPING AND R33_WITH_RECHARGE)
  install(TARGETS original_preprocess_tests seg_post_tests original_input_contract_tests exact_input_tests RUNTIME DESTINATION tests COMPONENT SharedSDK)
  if(UNIX)
    set_target_properties(original_preprocess_tests seg_post_tests original_input_contract_tests exact_input_tests PROPERTIES INSTALL_RPATH "$ORIGIN/../lib")
  endif()
endif()

# Public feature declarations live beside their implementation.
get_directory_property(_modular_sdk_targets BUILDSYSTEM_TARGETS)
foreach(_modular_sdk_target IN LISTS _modular_sdk_targets)
  get_target_property(_modular_sdk_target_type ${_modular_sdk_target} TYPE)
  # include(CTest) also creates dashboard utility targets, which have no compiler.
  if(_modular_sdk_target_type STREQUAL "UTILITY")
    continue()
  endif()
  target_include_directories(${_modular_sdk_target} PUBLIC
    "${PERCEPTION_PROJECT_ROOT}/features/inference/backend/include"
    "${PERCEPTION_PROJECT_ROOT}/features/detection/backend/include"
    "${PERCEPTION_PROJECT_ROOT}/features/segmentation/backend/include")
endforeach()
install(DIRECTORY "${PERCEPTION_PROJECT_ROOT}/features/inference/backend/include/" DESTINATION include)
install(DIRECTORY "${PERCEPTION_PROJECT_ROOT}/features/detection/backend/include/" DESTINATION include)
install(DIRECTORY "${PERCEPTION_PROJECT_ROOT}/features/segmentation/backend/include/" DESTINATION include)
